correctness.rationale: All positive and zero gap cases are exhausted by a cyclic three-gap encoding; rotating the two positive-gap decrement vectors gives only all-equal and (t,t,t-1) possible collisions. Deleted-one outputs are classified by unordered two-zero gaps. The six disjoint structural strata have rational orbit-count series and agree with an independent Burnside total. A separate direct canonical deletion implementation and coefficient checker test 981 gap orbits, source length 3..18 and exact series 3..57; finite tests corroborate, not replace, the all-n proof.

value.rationale: A natural sparse-composition deletion-channel geometry has nonuniform cyclic output shadows with a sharp six-class spectrum. The separate zero-gap collision at (t,t,t-1), one short exceptional source, and an exact all-length generating-function classification are needed to quantify output coverage for constant-composition necklace code packing. This precise inverse-shadow invariant is motivated independently by deletion-channel packing rather than by a parameter-slice whim. It does not claim a code optimum.
